results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Full-year earnings guidance reiterated, with profit before tax for 2026 expected to be slightly higher than 2025
results.summary: Sabre reports 14.3% premium growth year-on-year with strong performance in Motor Vehicle (16.5%) and Motorcycle (52.9%) segments. The company has reiterated full-year earnings guidance, expecting profit before tax to be slightly higher than 2025. While the CEO describes this as 'slightly ahead of 2025', the guidance is explicitly described as 'reiterated' rather than upgraded, indicating management is maintaining prior expectations rather than beating them. Premium growth and margin improvement are progressing as anticipated, with the company maintaining pricing discipline and delivering results consistent with prior guidance. The Ambition 2030 target remains on track.

results.headline: Capital Market Event Update
results.key_quote: We continue to make good operational progress with the Civil Service Pension Scheme contract. Capita recognises further improvement in service is required, and we are implementing further automation and strengthening governance.
results.summary: Capita postponed its Capital Market Event and provided a trading update focused on the Civil Service Pension Scheme contract. The company reports making good operational progress with planned feature rollouts and new tools, but acknowledges that further service improvements are needed. The company is working with the Cabinet Office on a recovery plan. No comparison to expectations or guidance is provided in this announcement.

results.headline: Half Year Results
results.key_quote: I am pleased to report another strong period for B.P. Marsh. The first half of the financial year saw us convert value built up across the portfolio into cash, delivering meaningful returns to shareholders while continuing to invest for future growth.
results.summary: B.P. Marsh delivered ahead of expectations with record dividends of £13.0m (36.29p per share) paid in the year to date, a 7.0% total shareholder return during the period, and NAV growth to £372.2m (1,048.5p per share). The company exceeded its capital recycling model with £30.8m in equity proceeds and loan repayments received from the portfolio, completed three new investments, and announced a minimum dividend of £7.0m intended for FY2028. Management emphasized the strength of results relative to their strategic objectives and the company's ability to deliver long-term value through their proven partnership-led model.
metrics_ahead: Strong total shareholder return of 7.0% during the period and 10.2% for twelve months
NAV per share growth to 1,048.5p from 1,009.9p
Significant equity proceeds and loan repayments of £30.8m from portfolio
Successful completion of three new investments plus follow-on investment

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Trading in the current financial year to date is in line with market expectations
results.summary: Trifast reported H1 FY27 trading in line with market expectations. Revenue declined 4.2% year-on-year (better than prior 7.1%), gross margin held steady at 28.7%, and underlying EBIT margin improved 80bps to 7.4%. The Board expects to achieve double-digit EBIT margins in H2 FY27 ahead of stated timeframe, demonstrating confidence in margin trajectory. However, the explicit statement 'Trading in line with market expectations' is the primary classification driver, with no indication of beating consensus forecasts for revenue (£214m) or adjusted EBIT (£18.2m).
metrics_ahead: underlying EBIT margin improvement of 80bps to 7.4%
moderated revenue decline to 4.2% vs prior 7.1%
targeting double-digit EBIT margins in H2 FY27 ahead of stated timeframe

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: full-year Adjusted EBITDA to be approximately 10% to 20% ahead of current market expectations of £9.4 million
results.summary: James Cropper has delivered strong H1 FY27 performance ahead of Board expectations, with particularly strong contribution from Paper & Packaging business. The Board has upgraded full-year guidance, now expecting Adjusted EBITDA to be 10-20% ahead of current market expectations (range £10.3m-£11.3m vs market expectation of £9.4m). CEO confirmed expectations have increased by 10-20%.
metrics_ahead: H1 trading ahead of Board expectations
Paper & Packaging revenue growth stronger than anticipated
Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance upgraded 10-20% above market expectations

results.headline: Half Year Trading Update
results.key_quote: Trading remains in line with the Board's expectations. Remains on track to deliver FY27 results in line with current market expectations
results.summary: Optima Health reported H1 FY27 revenue of approximately £96 million, representing 60% growth over the prior year period, driven by PAM Healthcare acquisition and organic growth. However, the company explicitly states trading is 'in line with the Board's expectations' and expects full year FY27 results to be 'in line with market expectations'. While revenue growth is strong year-on-year, this represents meeting rather than beating guidance, with no indication of upgraded expectations or outperformance versus forecasts.

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: FY26 revenues expected to be £8.3 million (2025: £6.5 million), beating market expectations. This additional growth exceeds the upgraded revenue guidance of 7 July 2026 (which moved revenue expectations from £7.5 million to £8.0 million)
results.summary: IXICO reported FY26 revenues of £8.3 million, representing 28% year-on-year growth and beating market expectations. The company exceeded its own upgraded guidance of £8.0 million issued on 7 July 2026 (upgraded from £7.5 million), driven by acceleration in analysis orders in the final quarter. Full year EBITDA loss is expected to improve on market expectations of a £1.7 million loss. Order book increased to £16.0 million and cash position strengthened to £10.4 million, providing visibility and resources for future growth.

results.headline: Half Year Trading Update
results.key_quote: First-half trading in line with Board expectations
results.summary: Gear4music reported H1 FY27 revenues of £85.4m (+6% YoY), gross profit of £23.6m, and EBITDA of £5.7m. Management explicitly states that revenue growth was 'in line with Board expectations' and 'first-half trading in line with Board expectations'. The Board expects full-year financial performance to be 'in line with consensus market expectations' (revenue £200.2m, EBITDA £16.0m, PBT £6.0m). While gross profit grew and revenue showed positive growth, the company has not indicated performance ahead of expectations. EBITDA declined year-on-year due to anticipated setup costs for the new automated warehouse, which was previously reported.

results.headline: Trading Statement
results.key_quote: Following the upgraded guidance provided at the half year, the Group continues to perform in line with expectations and reiterates its full year outlook.
results.summary: Bunzl delivered good underlying revenue growth of 3.7% in Q3 2026, driven by volume growth in North America Distribution and inflation effects. Operating margin was in line with expectations. The company explicitly states it is 'performing in line with expectations' and reiterates its full year guidance that was upgraded at the half year. While results are described as 'good' and demonstrate business resilience, there is no indication of beating expectations in the current quarter - rather, performance is consistent with the previously upgraded guidance and expectations.

results.headline: Positive Drill Rig Study Results
results.key_quote: The completion of this study is an important step forward for the Walton-Morant licence. It supports our ongoing farmout process, providing practical insight into rig and equipment availability and critical path items required to access the greater than 1 billion barrel mean prospective resources.
results.summary: United Oil & Gas announced positive results from a drilling rig and long-lead availability study for the Walton Morant licence offshore Jamaica. The study identifies a substantial pool of available rigs, outlines long-lead requirements, and establishes a Jamaica-based logistics model to support future exploration. However, this is a forward-planning and market assessment study that does not constitute a commitment to drill. The announcement supports the company's ongoing farm-out process but contains no financial results, operational metrics, or comparison to market or board expectations. No guidance upgrade, maintenance, or change is stated.

results.headline: Trading Statement
results.key_quote: The Group's FY27 outlook is in line with recently revised market expectations, with FY27 revenue growth expected to be 1-3%
results.summary: GB Group reports 1H27 results with 4.5% revenue growth in core segments (Location and Identity). While Location showed strong 8.9% growth and EMEA Identity performed well with double-digit growth outside Americas, the company faced headwinds from Americas Identity attrition. Adjusted operating profit of £27.0m was impacted by GBG Go investment and exceptional costs. The FY27 outlook is explicitly stated as 'in line with recently revised market expectations' with revenue growth of 1-3% and adjusted operating profit expected to align with current market expectations. The Global Fraud Solutions non-core business declined more than expected.
metrics_ahead: GBG Go momentum and volume ramp

results.summary: This is a takeover offer acceptance update announcement. Glenstone REIT has increased its offer for Alternative Income REIT from 70.0 pence to 71.4 pence per share and reports achieving 86.13% acceptance as of 19 October 2026. The announcement contains no comparison of AIRE's operational performance versus expectations, no financial results, and no guidance on future performance. It is purely a transactional update regarding the progress of the acquisition offer.

results.headline: 3rd Quarter Results
results.key_quote: We maintain our guidance for the Adjusted EBITDA for 2026 to be in the range of US$ 105 - 115 million, assuming the geopolitical situation doesn't materially impact vessel utilization.
results.summary: GMS reported 9M 2026 results with adjusted revenue up 10% to US$151.8m driven by new vessel operation and improved day rates, but offset by lower utilisation (80% vs 88%). Adjusted EBITDA remained flat at US$81.5m year-on-year. The company maintained its 2026 full-year guidance range of US$105-115m EBITDA, indicating results are tracking in line with expectations rather than ahead. While Q3 showed improvement and backlog grew 35%, the flat EBITDA performance and maintenance (not upgrade) of guidance suggest in-line execution.
metrics_ahead: Average day rates improved to US$39.1k (+9%)
Net leverage ratio improved to 1.55x from 1.63x

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: As a result of these conditions, the Group now expects full year Underlying Operating Profit to be approximately £84 million
results.summary: Genuit has lowered its full year Underlying Operating Profit guidance to approximately £84m, which falls below analyst consensus forecasts of £91m-£96m. While the company reports resilience in some areas with revenue up 3.5% YoY on a reported basis, the like-for-like revenue decline of 4.3% and the guidance reduction reflect material challenges from macroeconomic headwinds, unseasonably warm weather impacting heating volumes, and weak RMI-exposed markets. The company acknowledges worsening conditions in specific markets since August interim results.

results.headline: Q3 Trading Update
results.key_quote: We expect a combination of revenue growth and associated operational leverage to deliver a FY27 performance slightly ahead of current market expectations
results.summary: XP Power reported record Q3 order intake of £106.8m (93% growth YoY in constant currency) with improving revenue momentum. Q3 revenue of £63.8m was in line with expectations. FY26 expectations remain unchanged. Critically, the company stated it expects FY27 performance to be 'slightly ahead of current market expectations', representing guidance that is ahead of analyst consensus. The strong order book (£216.9m) and improving operational performance support this forward-looking statement.
metrics_ahead: FY27 guidance stated as slightly ahead of market expectations

results.headline: Molaoi Update
results.key_quote: The interval of mineralisation drilled in hole HMO-021 is exceptional and we are very pleased to be getting such broad intervals of massive and semi-massive mineralisation.
results.summary: Rockfire Resources reported drilling results from hole HMO-021 at the Molaoi zinc deposit in Greece, highlighting multiple zinc intervals with wide grades including an 11m zone at 5.0% Zn and record high zinc grades. The company noted exceptional mineralisation and record individual zinc grades, but made no comparison to market, analyst or board expectations. The announcement is an operational update providing exploration results without stating performance versus any guidance or forecasts.

results.headline: Q3 Trading Update
results.key_quote: we are on track to meet consensus expectations which on average show a growth in adjusted PBT of c. 10% for 2026
results.summary: Wickes reported Q3 2026 revenue growth of 4.5% with strong performance in Retail (6.0% growth) and market share gains. The company explicitly states it is 'on track to meet consensus expectations' for adjusted PBT growth of approximately 10% for full year 2026. This is an in-line classification as the company is meeting (not exceeding) market/consensus expectations rather than beating them.

results.headline: Replacement: Investment update - Paraytec
results.key_quote: Successful completion of Phase 2 is an important technical de-risking step for the programme.
results.summary: Truetide reported successful completion of Phase 2 of a proof-of-concept programme between its investee Paraytec and VosBio on breath-derived extracellular vesicle collection and analysis. Key technical milestones were achieved including recovery of EV-like particles from simulated air samples and demonstration of repeatable signals with negligible carryover on the CX300 platform. However, this is an investment update on a technical milestone with no comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance. The announcement is primarily a factual technical progress report rather than a results announcement with forward guidance.
